answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 13 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 420 identities costs 420 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The garden of the design is public, the lotus of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the wander of honest work is what finally pays.
